title: saucectl authoring runner configuration
description: Configuration file for running AI-authored (Sauce Test Authoring) test suites using saucectl

suites.description: The set of AI-authored test suites to run.

name.description: The name of the test suite, which will be reflected in the test results in Sauce Labs.

testSuiteId.description: The Sauce Labs test suite ID to run, as created by `saucectl author` / `saucectl author sync`.

tags.description: Tags to apply to each test case run triggered for this suite.

timeout.description: How long to wait for a single test case's job(s) to finish before treating it as timed out.
